area_description: Leadership, policy, and organizational governance controls.
standard_description: The laboratory is easily identifiable.
indicator_text: The laboratory is identifiable with name on a sign board
required_evidence_description: Sign board clearly displaying name of the laboratory or the collection center as the case may be.; Sign board/s placed appropriately for clear visibility.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by the essence of the indicator is to ascertain that any one approaching the laboratory is able to identify the location of the laboratory with the help of a board on which name of the lab is clearly written. Evidence should show: Sign board clearly displaying name of the laboratory or the collection center as the case may be.; Sign board/s placed appropriately for clear visibility. Scoring note: If there is a sign board which clearly identifies the laboratory and specifies whether it is a laboratory or a collection center, then score as fully met. If there is no sign board to clearly identify the laboratory as above, then score as not met.

area_description: Leadership, policy, and organizational governance controls.
standard_description: The laboratory is easily identifiable.
indicator_text: The laboratory sign board conforms to the prescribed local legal standards
required_evidence_description: Sign board size should conform to the local legal standards.; Sign board fixation should conform to the local legal/technical/safety standards.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by this requires surveyor knowledge about the local laws which prescribe the specifications/standards for the sign boards regarding their size, place of fixation and the type and strength of fixation. Evidence should show: Sign board size should conform to the local legal standards.; Sign board fixation should conform to the local legal/technical/safety standards. Scoring note: If the sign board conforms to the local legal standards as above, then score as fully met. If the sign board has non conformity to the local legal standards, then score as not met.

area_description: Leadership, policy, and organizational governance controls.
standard_description: The laboratory is easily identifiable.
indicator_text: The laboratory is registered / licensed with the PHC
required_evidence_description: PHC registration / license number clearly displayed on the sign board/separately.; Registration certificate/license with PHC displayed at a prominent place inside the laboratory.; Copy of PM&DC registration certificate of the Pathologist heading the laboratory displayed at a prominent place inside the laboratory.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by the surveyor is required to check the following in original before proceeding any further with the assessment / inspection; Registration Certificate / License/Provisional License under the PHC Act. Evidence should show: PHC registration / license number clearly displayed on the sign board/separately.; Registration certificate/license with PHC displayed at a prominent place inside the laboratory.; Copy of PM&DC registration certificate of the Pathologist heading the laboratory displayed at a prominent place inside the laboratory. Scoring note: If the laboratory has displayed Registration Certificate or valid License/provisional license issued by the PHC, then score as fully met. If Registration Certificate is displayed and license with PHC is under process, then score as partially met. If none of...

area_description: Leadership, policy, and organizational governance controls.
standard_description: The laboratory is easily identifiable.
indicator_text: Associated collection canters are reflected in the registration certificate / license issued by the PHC
required_evidence_description: Evidence of reflecting the list of collection centers of the laboratory, if any, in the application for registration/license with the PHC.; Registration Certificate of laboratory / collection centers under PHC Act accordingly having License/Provisional License # linked with serial # of the Collection Center (clinical / Pathology Laboratory Reg #/Collection Center serial # in the list) e.g. (PCL#/CC#).; Evidence of having applied for licensure in case it is not licensed.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by the list of the collection centers attached with a particular lab are required to be reflected in the application for registration/ license. The surveyor is required to check the following; Evidence should show: Evidence of reflecting the list of collection centers of the laboratory, if any, in the application for registration/license with the PHC.; Registration Certificate of laboratory / collection centers under PHC Act accordingly having License/Provisional License # linked with serial # of the Collection Center (clinical / Pathology Laboratory Reg #/Collection Center serial # in the list) e.g. (PCL#/CC#).; Evidence of having applied for licensure in case it is not licensed. Scoring note: If valid Registration Certificate of PHC for collection centers exists, then score as fully met. If certification is under process, then score as partially met. If no valid Registration Certificate of the PHC or no evidence of having applied for it, then sc...

area_description: Leadership, policy, and organizational governance controls.
standard_description: The laboratory is easily identifiable.
indicator_text: Signed valid MOU, showing linkage with any other laboratory or organization for referral of specialized tests, exists.
required_evidence_description: Written and valid MOU with referral laboratory which fulfills above requirements.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by majority of the laboratories do not perform all the test / full range of lab tests . Therefore, some laboratories send samples to other relevant laboratories for getting specific tests performed. Evidence should show: Written and valid MOU with referral laboratory which fulfills above requirements. Scoring note: If signed and valid MOU/documented system of referral with other laboratories exists, then score as fully met. If no such evidence of referral system exists, then score as not met.

area_description: Leadership, policy, and organizational governance controls.
standard_description: A technically qualified and experienced individual heads the laboratory
indicator_text: The individual heading the laboratory has requisite and appropriate technical qualification and experience
required_evidence_description: A Pathologist currently withhaving valid PM&DC registration is appointed as technical head of the laboratory.; The qualification of the pathologist is commensurate with the scope of service of the laboratory.; JD of the head of the laboratory in addition to other duties includes the binding clause regarding physical presence of pathologist for the time required in line with the scope of services.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by director/individual heading the laboratory is responsible for the overall operation and administration. Evidence should show: A Pathologist currently withhaving valid PM&DC registration is appointed as technical head of the laboratory.; The qualification of the pathologist is commensurate with the scope of service of the laboratory.; JD of the head of the laboratory in addition to other duties includes the binding clause regarding physical presence of pathologist for the time required in line with the scope of services. Scoring note: If qualification and experience of the director/individual heading the laboratory meets the technical requirements, then score as fully met. If qualification and experience of director/individual heading the laboratory is deficient, then score as not met.

area_description: Leadership, policy, and organizational governance controls.
standard_description: Responsibilities of management are defined
indicator_text: Those responsible for lab management lay down the laboratory's mission statement.
required_evidence_description: Documented mission statement that fulfills the above requirements; Mission statement is and displayed for the staff and patients to view.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by mission statement of a clinical laboratory is a statement of core purpose and focus that normally remains unchanged over time, hence is required to be prepared by the top management. Evidence should show: Documented mission statement that fulfills the above requirements; Mission statement is and displayed for the staff and patients to view. Scoring note: If there is a documented mission statement and it is displayed, then score as fully met. If there is a documented mission statement but not displayed, then score as partially met. If there is no documented mission statement, then score as not met.

area_description: Leadership, policy, and organizational governance controls.
standard_description: Responsibilities of management are defined
indicator_text: Those responsible for management lay down detailed Laboratory Policy and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
required_evidence_description: Written laboratory Policy and SOPs available.; Evidence of involvement of senior leadership, including those involved in the laboratory’s management, in the process of developing policy and SOPs.; Staff is aware of the laboratory Policy and SOPs.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by the management of clinical laboratories must develop, implement and maintain laboratory policy covering lab-specific processes and procedures /SOPs. Evidence should show: Written laboratory Policy and SOPs available.; Evidence of involvement of senior leadership, including those involved in the laboratory’s management, in the process of developing policy and SOPs.; Staff is aware of the laboratory Policy and SOPs. Scoring note: If the laboratory’s Policy and SOPs are documented with evidence of involvement of the appropriate leadership in their development and staff is aware of it, then score as fully met. If there is no Policy and SOPs, then score as not met.

area_description: Leadership, policy, and organizational governance controls.
standard_description: Responsibilities of management are defined
indicator_text: Those responsible for management lay down emergency policy and Standard Operating Procedures.
required_evidence_description: Written laboratory Emergency Policy and SOPs covering the above requirements.; The Emergency Policy and SOPs are available to the staff / patients for consultation.; The staff is aware of the emergency policy and SOPs.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by check laboratory Policy and SOPs for emergency situations like accidents, natural calamities, and epidemics etc. and ask how these were developed. Evidence should show: Written laboratory Emergency Policy and SOPs covering the above requirements.; The Emergency Policy and SOPs are available to the staff / patients for consultation.; The staff is aware of the emergency policy and SOPs. Scoring note: If the Emergency Policy & SOPs exist with evidence of involvement of the appropriate senior leadership and staff is aware of it, then score as fully met. If the Emergency Policy & SOPs exist as above but about 20% of staff is not aware of those, then score...

area_description: Leadership, policy, and organizational governance controls.
standard_description: Responsibilities of management are defined
indicator_text: Those responsible for management approve sufficient laboratory budget and allocate the resources required to accomplish the mission.
required_evidence_description: The premises of the laboratory has adequate space suitable for the required activities.; The staff, equipment and consumables remain available to support the scope of laboratory services.; No evidence of delay in reporting the test results on account of non-availability of equipment, kits/reagents or the concerned staff.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by review any documentary evidence for lack of resources (kits etc.). Evidence is available in the form of delayed reporting or refusal of tests to the patients etc. Evidence should show: The premises of the laboratory has adequate space suitable for the required activities.; The staff, equipment and consumables remain available to support the scope of laboratory services.; No evidence of delay in reporting the test results on account of non-availability of equipment, kits/reagents or the concerned staff. Scoring note: If there is a no evidence of lack of resources, then score as fully met. If there is evidence of lack of resources, then score as not met.

area_description: Leadership, policy, and organizational governance controls.
standard_description: Responsibilities of management are defined
indicator_text: Those responsible for management establish the laboratory's organogram.
required_evidence_description: The Organogram prepared as above is documented.; The organogram is displayed for patients and the staff.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by an organizational chart/organogram shows the structure/plan of the laboratory that gives the job titles of all the staff showing how they are connected /reporting to each other. Evidence should show: The Organogram prepared as above is documented.; The organogram is displayed for patients and the staff. Scoring note: If there is an updated organizational chart (“organogram”) which is displayed, then score as fully met. If there is an updated organizational chart (“organogram”) but it is not displayed, then score as partially met. If there is none, then score as not met.

area_description: Leadership, policy, and organizational governance controls.
standard_description: Responsibilities of management are defined
indicator_text: Those responsible for management appoint the section heads in the laboratory.
required_evidence_description: The section heads are appointed; Evidence of adopting due process for appointing section heads i.e. under the signatures of the technical head of the laboratory.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by laboratory section head is responsible for overall functioning of a particular section according to laid down policy. Review the process for appointment of the laboratory’s section heads / lead experts. Evidence should show: The section heads are appointed; Evidence of adopting due process for appointing section heads i.e. under the signatures of the technical head of the laboratory. Scoring note: If there is a clearly defined process for appointment of the section heads / lead experts, then score as fully met. If the process is limited to the laboratory’s director / in charge only, then score as partially met. If there is no formal process, then sco...

area_description: Leadership, policy, and organizational governance controls.
standard_description: Responsibilities of management are defined
indicator_text: Those responsible for management support research activities.
required_evidence_description: Research approved by the management and its printed report. OR; Record of sharing disease related data with relevant authorities /research organizations ensuring patient confidentiality.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by all research must be formally approved by the laboratory Director in consultation with other team members. Review any research reports approved by the management team and support extended for research. Evidence should show: Research approved by the management and its printed report. OR; Record of sharing disease related data with relevant authorities /research organizations ensuring patient confidentiality. Scoring note: If there is documented evidence of the research activities, then score as fully met. If there is no research of any kind conducted or underway, then score as not met.

area_description: Facility design, legal compliance, and emergency safety controls.
standard_description: The management is aware of and complies with the relevant laws, bylaws, rules and regulations, and facility inspection requirements under the relevant building and associated codes applicable to laboratories.
indicator_text: The management is conversant with the relevant laws and regulations and knows their applicability to the laboratory
required_evidence_description: Copies of current/updated relevant laws, regulations and rules available (Annexure-A).; Laboratory staff is aware of the relevant laws, regulations and rules and knows as to how the those relate to their functioning.; Compliance of relevant laws, regulations and rules is observable.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by the surveyor may demand copies of the relevant laws and regulations which should include building, fire safety, and safety requirements for lifts/elevators as and where applicable. Evidence should show: Copies of current/updated relevant laws, regulations and rules available (Annexure-A).; Laboratory staff is aware of the relevant laws, regulations and rules and knows as to how the those relate to their functioning.; Compliance of relevant laws, regulations and rules is observable. area_description: Facility design, legal compliance, and emergency safety controls.
standard_description: The management is aware of and complies with the relevant laws, bylaws, rules and regulations, and facility inspection requirements under the relevant building and associated codes applicable to laboratories.
indicator_text: The management regularly updates any amendments in the prevailing relevant laws and rules
required_evidence_description: Evidence that process to keep the relevant laws, regulations and rules properly updated is adopted.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by surveyors are required to check for evidence of routinely updated laws, rules and regulations. This needs an updated copy/amendment done accordingly, duly signed for authenticity of record. Evidence should show: Evidence that process to keep the relevant laws, regulations and rules properly updated is adopted. Scoring note: If there is an evidence of a process to identify and acknowledge changes in laws and regulations, then score as fully met. If there is no evidence of an update process, then score as not met.

area_description: Facility design, legal compliance, and emergency safety controls.
standard_description: The management is aware of and complies with the relevant laws, bylaws, rules and regulations, and facility inspection requirements under the relevant building and associated codes applicable to laboratories.
indicator_text: The management ensures implementation of these requirements
required_evidence_description: Evidence that the relevant laws, regulations and rules are properly implemented, for example:; Implementation of PHWM Rules 2014 in such a way that all key requirements are clearly observable.; Compliance of the building and fire safety requirements etc.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by the general requirements listed in various rules and regulations illustrate some of the basic health and safety elements to be implemented in all new and remodeled buildings to be used as laboratories. Evidence should show: Evidence that the relevant laws, regulations and rules are properly implemented, for example:; Implementation of PHWM Rules 2014 in such a way that all key requirements are clearly observable.; Compliance of the building and fire safety requirements etc. Scoring note: If there is evidence of implementation of all prevailing laws and regulations, then score as fully met. If there is up to 80% compliance, then score as partially met. If there is less than 80% compliance, then score as not met.

area_description: Facility design, legal compliance, and emergency safety controls.
standard_description: Facility work flow design conforms the scope of services.
indicator_text: Space allocation and effective separation between administrative and technical laboratory areas
required_evidence_description: Laboratory design/layout that ensures:; Safe environment for patients and the staff.; Clear separation of technical areas and administrative/patient waiting areas.; Uni-directional workflow.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by the primary objective in laboratory design is to provide a safe and facilitative environment for laboratory personnel to conduct their work. Evidence should show: Laboratory design/layout that ensures:; Safe environment for patients and the staff.; Clear separation of technical areas and administrative/patient waiting areas.; Uni-directional workflow. Scoring note: If there is sufficient space and clear separation of different administrative and technical areas, then score as fully met. If there is insufficient space and separation between administrative and technical areas, then score as not met.

area_description: Facility design, legal compliance, and emergency safety controls.
standard_description: Facility work flow design conforms the scope of services.
indicator_text: Measures to limit unauthorized access to work areas of the laboratory
required_evidence_description: Laboratory technical working areas have controlled access/entry.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by check availability of measures for limited access to the working areas of laboratory. Evidence should show: Laboratory technical working areas have controlled access/entry. Scoring note: If authorized technical staff is wearing Identity (ID) cards and entries of work areas is monitored, then score as fully met. If there are no measure to check the access as above, then score as not met.

area_description: Facility design, legal compliance, and emergency safety controls.
standard_description: The laboratory has plans for fire and non-fire emergencies within the sections.
indicator_text: Plans and provisions for early detection of fire and non-fire emergencies exist
required_evidence_description: Plan for fire and non-fire emergencies.; The plan addresses the requirement of early detection of fire and non-fire emergencies.; The provisions to detect the above emergency situations at an early stage as laid out in the plan e.g.:; Smoke detector/s.; Monitoring through CCTV cameras.; Trained staff physically deployed to ensure the required outcome.; The staff is aware of the plan.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by review the plan to ensure that it addresses the requirement of detection of fire and non-fire emergency situations. Evidence should show: Plan for fire and non-fire emergencies.; The plan addresses the requirement of early detection of fire and non-fire emergencies.; The provisions to detect the above emergency situations at an early stage as laid out in the plan e.g.:; Smoke detector/s.; Monitoring through CCTV cameras.; Trained staff physically deployed to ensure the required outcome.; The staff is aware of the plan. Scoring note: If the plan and provisions to detect the above emergency situations at an early stage exist and staff is aware of it, then score as fully met. If emergency plan does not exist, then score as not met.

area_description: Facility design, legal compliance, and emergency safety controls.
standard_description: The laboratory has plans for fire and non-fire emergencies within the sections.
indicator_text: Provisions for abatement of fire and non-fire emergencies exist
required_evidence_description: The plan providing for an environment which has lesser chances of occurrence of fire and non-fire emergencies viz:; There is no loose electric wiring to cause short circuiting.; No loose plugs and sockets which can spark.; No power cord/s that is/are worn out to cause electrocution.; Ramps if exist are non-slippery.; Stairs have supporting rails etc.; Building meets, the local construction standards.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by review the plan to ensure that it addresses the requirement of abatement of fire and non-fire emergencies. Evidence should show: The plan providing for an environment which has lesser chances of occurrence of fire and non-fire emergencies viz:; There is no loose electric wiring to cause short circuiting.; No loose plugs and sockets which can spark.; No power cord/s that is/are worn out to cause electrocution.; Ramps if exist are non-slippery.; Stairs have supporting rails etc.; Building meets, the local construction standards. Scoring note: If the plan includes the requirements and there is evidence that these are implemented, then score as fully met. Since this is an important patient safety issue, if the requirement is not included in the plan, or if not clearly implemented, then score as no...

area_description: Facility design, legal compliance, and emergency safety controls.
standard_description: The laboratory has plans for fire and non-fire emergencies within the sections.
indicator_text: Provisions for containment of fire emergencies exist
required_evidence_description: Water Source / buckets.; Sand buckets.; Shovel.; Fire extinguisher/s.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by provision of emergency containment resources should be checked by the surveyors e.g. water, sand buckets, fire extinguishers etc. Evidence should show: Water Source / buckets.; Sand buckets.; Shovel.; Fire extinguisher/s. Scoring note: If water, sand buckets, fire extinguishers etc. are present, then score as fully met. If there is none availability of fire emergency containment resources, then score as not met.

area_description: Facility design, legal compliance, and emergency safety controls.
standard_description: The laboratory has plans for fire and non-fire emergencies within the sections.
indicator_text: Displayed safe exit points in case of fire and non-fire emergencies exist
required_evidence_description: Emergency Exit points 24/7 illuminated sign board/s displayed.; No obstructions at any time on the emergency exits.; Staff is aware of the emergency exits.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by the surveyor is required to observe availability of displayed safe exit points. Physically check emergency exits and also make sure that there are no obstructions in front of emergency exits. Evidence should show: Emergency Exit points 24/7 illuminated sign board/s displayed.; No obstructions at any time on the emergency exits.; Staff is aware of the emergency exits. Scoring note: If the safe exit points existare displayed as described above and are displayed, then score as fully met. If the safe exit points are either not maintained or not displayed as described above, then score as not met.

area_description: Facility design, legal compliance, and emergency safety controls.

fulfillment_guidance: Verify by regular “mock” drills should be conducted in different shifts and sections of the laboratory. Evidence should show: Record of Mock Drills / attendance.; Record confirms that all staff was subjected to the mock drill.; Record of corrective actions taken after mock drills. Scoring note: If there is documented evidence that mock drills are held at least once in the past one year and that they involved the staff in different sections and shifts, then score as fully met. If no mock drill is conducted or there is/are non-conformities with the...

area_description: Facility design, legal compliance, and emergency safety controls.
standard_description: The laboratory has plans for fire and non-fire emergencies within the sections.
indicator_text: Staff members are trained for their role in case of such emergencies
required_evidence_description: Record that confirms participation of at least the key staff from each shift.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by staff members are trained for dealing with fire emergencies. They are to be imparted certified trainings preferably by Rescue 1122 / Civil Defense / any other recognized body. Evidence should show: Record that confirms participation of at least the key staff from each shift. Scoring note: If there is documented evidence of training of staff from every duty shift, then score as fully met. If trained personnel are not available in every duty shift, then score as partially met. If no training is imparted, then score as not met.

area_description: Workforce deployment, orientation, appraisal, and personnel records.
standard_description: Staff deployment is in accordance with the scope of laboratory work
indicator_text: Job description for every post is identified and documented
required_evidence_description: Documented individual Job Descriptions.; Every JD bears the signatures of the employer and the concerned employee.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by job description (JD) is a listed description that a person uses for tasks or functions, and responsibilities of a position. Evidence should show: Documented individual Job Descriptions.; Every JD bears the signatures of the employer and the concerned employee. Scoring note: If all posts have documented job description, then score as fully met. If there is no job description or there are non-compliances, then score as not met.

area_description: Workforce deployment, orientation, appraisal, and personnel records.

Scoring note: If there are written eligibility criteria for every post, then score as fully met. If there are written eligibility criteria for every post, then score as fully met. area_description: Workforce deployment, orientation, appraisal, and personnel records.

fulfillment_guidance: Verify by eligibility criteria regarding the employee’s qualification, disciplinary background and experience should be strictly followed for quality recruitments. Scoring note: If all reviewed files have relevant qualification and experience certificates/ documents and are according to eligibility criteria, then score as fully met. area_description: Workforce deployment, orientation, appraisal, and personnel records.
standard_description: The staff members joining the laboratory are oriented to the laboratory environment, the laboratory sections and their individual jobs.
indicator_text: Appropriate orientation plan for new inducted employee exists
required_evidence_description: Written Orientation Plan covering the following:; general laboratory working; Safety; Biosafety; Quality assurance; SOPs; Specific techniques/tasks assigned to the individual employees
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by orientation should be on general laboratory working, safety, biosafety, quality assurance, standard operating procedures and on specific techniques/tasks assigned to the employee. Evidence should show: Written Orientation Plan covering the following:; general laboratory working; Safety; Biosafety; Quality assurance; SOPs; Specific techniques/tasks assigned to the individual employees Scoring note: If there is written orientation plan covering all of the above mentioned topics, then score as fully met. If there is written orientation plan covering at least 80% of the above mentioned topics, then score as partially met. If there is no orientation plan...

area_description: Workforce deployment, orientation, appraisal, and personnel records.
standard_description: The staff members joining the laboratory are oriented to the laboratory environment, the laboratory sections and their individual jobs.
indicator_text: Each staff member is made aware of laboratory wide policies and procedures as well as section/unit/service/program specific policies and procedures
required_evidence_description: Written record of level specific orientation sessions conducted for all staff covering:; Laboratory wide policy and procedures (General SOPs).; Section/unit/service/program specific policies and procedures.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by assess knowledge of the staff regarding above mentioned policies/SOPs by evaluating against the contents of orientation plan. area_description: Workforce deployment, orientation, appraisal, and personnel records.
standard_description: The staff members joining the laboratory are oriented to the laboratory environment, the laboratory sections and their individual jobs.
indicator_text: Each staff member is made aware of his/her rights and responsibilities
required_evidence_description: Written record of JD which hasjob contract having clear description of employee rights and responsibilities.; JD duly signed by the employee and the employer.
fulfillment_guidance: Verify by this would require that each staff member has a written job contract that defines specific responsibilities and employee rights as per PHC Charters/labor laws that is shared with the staff member at the time of induction. Scoring note: If each staff member has a written job contract as above, then score as fully met. If any staff member does not have a written job contract or if there is no formal way to let the member know of their rights and responsibilities, then score as not met

area_description: Workforce deployment, orientation, appraisal, and personnel records.

fulfillment_guidance: Verify by during the general laboratory orientation program, employees are educated about patient rights and responsibilities. Scoring note: If there is documented evidence that all staff members have been so educated and they are aware of it, then score as fully met. area_description: Workforce deployment, orientation, appraisal, and personnel records.

Scoring note: If the written performance appraisal / reporting format as above, is available, then score as fully met. If the written performance appraisal / reporting format is not available, then score as not met.

area_description: Workforce deployment, orientation, appraisal, and personnel records.

Scoring note: If employees are aware of appraisal system tools, then score as fully met. If employees are not aware of it, then score as not met.

area_description: Workforce deployment, orientation, appraisal, and personnel records.
standard_description: An appraisal system for evaluating the performance of employees exists as an integral part of the human resource management process.
indicator_text: The appraisal is used as a tool for further development.
